info.name: No Games On Netflix [Outdated]
info.description:
[Outdated]

This simple style hides games-related blocks on Netflix:

- The main billboard (when it's about games)
- The cloud games row
- The mobile games row

Plus fixes the layout after hiding the main billboard

Enjoy!
-- 
sEver
info.additionalInfo:
As of 2026-07-16 this Userstyle cannot be updated on this platform to a working version anymore, because userstyles.org code parser doesn't allow for the `:has()` CSS property and lists it as an error when uploaded.

Userstyle moved to:      https://userstyles.world/style/22338/no-games-on-netflix
